findings.text: The company was incorporated on 9 February 2022 and is recorded as 4.7 years old (1718 days).

PERSON 292 has 2 other appointments, both recorded as dissolved, and no other current companies were found across the checked director.
One registered office address change has been filed since 24 October 2025, dated 1 April 2026.
